# UmaLytics 0.5.3

## Fixes and improvements

- **Umas:** the catalog now scrolls inside its own panel. The toolbar stays in place, and the detail panel scrolls on its own.
- **Releases:** UmaLytics releases are now published only from kjunodev/umalytics.
- **License:** the project is now MIT-licensed.

## Update

Download and extract the ZIP for your browser. Disable the previous extension, load the new build, reopen UmaLytics and refresh your drafter tabs. Confirm **v0.5.3** in the header.

The Chromium ZIP supports Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera GX. Firefox / LibreWolf uses an unsigned temporary add-on, which must be loaded again after a browser restart. SHA256SUMS.txt contains optional download integrity checksums.

Automated regression, type and build checks passed before release; they do not replace live installed-browser testing.
